description: A supplied sequence of valid finite selections starting empty and extending by one term gives a choice function whose length-n prefix is the nth supplied selection.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.WeakerChoice.selections_of_history_path.{u} {α : Type u} (A : ℕ → Set α) (p : ℕ → List α)
  (hzero : p 0 = []) (hvalid : ∀ (n : ℕ), Lemmatheca.SetTheory.WeakerChoice.SelectionHistory A (p n))
  (hstep : ∀ (n : ℕ), Lemmatheca.SetTheory.WeakerChoice.OneTermExtension (p n) (p (n + 1))) :
  ∃ c, (∀ (n : ℕ), c n ∈ A n) ∧ ∀ (n : ℕ), (List.ofFn fun i => c ↑i) = p n
